after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. When a promo code applies to an order that includes a return trip, the discount amount shown in the Mozio email confirmation is either missing, zero, or incorrect for the return leg. The outbound leg displays correctly. The root cause lies in the return-trip mapping path where discount/price-report data is not propagated or is dropped when the from/to stations are swapped for the return trip.
